description: This file defines an abstract repository interface for notes and a concrete implementation using SharedPreferences for persistent storage, including methods for loading, saving, deleting, and clearing notes, along with data seed logic.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for note storage operations: load, upsert, delete, clear.

classes.name: SharedPrefsNotesRepository
classes.description: A concrete implementation of NotesRepository using SharedPreferences, includes methods for managing notes in persistent storage.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads all notes from SharedPreferences, seeds with sample notes if none exist or data is corrupted.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates or updates a note, then sorts and saves the list.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a note by id from storage.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Removes all notes from storage, primarily for testing purposes.
